function textControlsCase(variant) {
 const checks={},p=document.createElement('div');
 p.innerHTML='<input value="start"><textarea>first\nline</textarea>';
 const input=p.firstChild,area=p.lastChild;
 if(typeof HTMLInputElement==='undefined'||typeof HTMLTextAreaElement==='undefined')return {interfaces:false};
 checks.interfaces=input instanceof HTMLInputElement && area instanceof HTMLTextAreaElement;
 checks.constructorArity=HTMLInputElement.length===0 && HTMLTextAreaElement.length===0;
 checks.brands=Object.prototype.toString.call(input)==='[object HTMLInputElement]' && Object.prototype.toString.call(area)==='[object HTMLTextAreaElement]';
 checks.initial=input.value==='start' && input.defaultValue==='start' && area.value==='first\nline' && area.defaultValue==='first\nline';
 input.setAttribute('value','fresh');checks.cleanAttribute=input.value==='fresh';
 input.value='owned-'+variant;input.defaultValue='default';
 checks.dirtyInput=input.value==='owned-'+variant && input.defaultValue==='default' && input.getAttribute('value')==='default';
 input.removeAttribute('value');checks.removedDefault=input.defaultValue==='' && input.value==='owned-'+variant;
 input.value='a\r\nb\nc\rd';checks.inputNewlines=input.value==='abcd';
 input.value=null;checks.inputNull=input.value==='';
 input.defaultValue=null;checks.defaultNull=input.defaultValue==='null' && input.value==='';
 area.textContent='clean\r\ntext\rtail';
 checks.cleanText=area.value==='clean\ntext\ntail' && area.defaultValue==='clean\r\ntext\rtail';
 area.value='dirty\r\ntext\rtail';area.defaultValue='replacement';
 checks.dirtyArea=area.value==='dirty\ntext\ntail' && area.defaultValue==='replacement' && area.textContent==='replacement';
 area.value=null;checks.areaNull=area.value==='';
 area.value='😀e\u0301';checks.utf16=area.textLength===4;
 input.name='query';area.name='notes';input.placeholder='find';area.placeholder='write';
 checks.strings=input.getAttribute('name')==='query' && area.name==='notes' && input.placeholder==='find' && area.getAttribute('placeholder')==='write';
 input.disabled=true;area.required=true;input.readOnly=true;area.readOnly=true;
 checks.booleans=input.hasAttribute('disabled') && input.disabled && area.required && input.hasAttribute('readonly') && area.readOnly;
 input.disabled=false;area.required=false;checks.booleanRemoval=!input.hasAttribute('disabled') && !area.hasAttribute('required');
 input.type='PASSWORD';input.value='a\nb';checks.type=input.type==='password' && input.value==='ab';
 input.type='unknown';checks.unknownType=input.type==='text';
 input.type='url';input.value=' \ta\n b\r ';checks.url=input.value==='a b';
 input.type='email';input.value=' \ta\n@b.test\r ';checks.email=input.value==='a@b.test';
 input.multiple=true;input.value=' a@b.test , c@d.test ';checks.emailMultiple=input.value==='a@b.test,c@d.test';
 input.type='text';input.value=12;checks.coercion=input.value==='12';
 const transitions=document.createElement('input');transitions.value=' a b ';transitions.setAttribute('type','url');transitions.setAttribute('type','text');checks.typeTransition=transitions.value==='a b';
 transitions.type='email';transitions.value='a@b.test , c@d.test';transitions.setAttribute('multiple','');transitions.removeAttribute('multiple');checks.multipleTransition=transitions.value==='a@b.test,c@d.test';
 transitions.type='text';transitions.value=' x ';transitions.getAttributeNode('type').value='url';transitions.getAttributeNode('type').value='text';checks.attributeNodeTransition=transitions.value==='x';
 let rejected=false;try{input.value=Symbol('x')}catch(e){rejected=e instanceof TypeError;}checks.symbol=rejected;
 const inputGet=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype,'value').get;
 const areaGet=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLTextAreaElement.prototype,'value').get;
 rejected=false;try{inputGet.call(area)}catch(e){rejected=e instanceof TypeError;}checks.inputReceiver=rejected;
 rejected=false;try{areaGet.call(input)}catch(e){rejected=e instanceof TypeError;}checks.areaReceiver=rejected;
 rejected=false;try{new HTMLInputElement()}catch(e){rejected=e instanceof TypeError;}checks.inputConstructor=rejected;
 rejected=false;try{new HTMLTextAreaElement()}catch(e){rejected=e instanceof TypeError;}checks.areaConstructor=rejected;
 const descriptor=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype,'value');checks.descriptor=descriptor.enumerable && descriptor.configurable && !Object.hasOwn(input,'value');
 const child=document.createElement('span');child.textContent='nested';const raw=document.createElement('textarea');raw.appendChild(child);raw.appendChild(document.createTextNode('direct'));
 checks.childText=raw.defaultValue==='direct' && raw.value==='direct' && raw.textContent==='nesteddirect';
 raw.value='retained';p.appendChild(raw);raw.remove();checks.detached=raw.value==='retained' && raw.parentNode===null;
 checks.sameWrapper=p.firstChild===input && p.firstChild.value==='12';
 const observer=new MutationObserver(()=>{});observer.observe(input,{attributes:true});input.value='no-attribute';checks.valueMutation=observer.takeRecords().length===0;input.defaultValue='new-default';const records=observer.takeRecords();checks.defaultMutation=records.length===1 && records[0].attributeName==='value';observer.disconnect();
 const many=document.createElement('textarea');many.value='last';for(let i=0;i<20;i++)many.value='value-'+i;checks.repeated= many.value==='value-19' && many.childNodes.length===0 && many.defaultValue==='';
 return checks;
}
